about:
KDR Wood Design Co. operates from Green Lake, Wisconsin, providing custom woodworking services for residential and commercial clients. The company is led by Kaleb, who oversees a team of experienced carpenters and designers.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, furniture, countertops, millwork, and mantles & shelves. As a full-service woodworking company, it also offers project management to keep jobs on schedule and on budget. The team handles projects of any scale, from kitchen remodels to whole-house additions.

KDR serves homeowners and businesses throughout the region. Recent projects include a garden workroom cabinetry, a large custom bookcase, a master bath breakfront, and various built-to-order pieces for a lake home. The company also works on kitchen and bath remodels, delivering finish carpentry and tile work.

KDR emphasizes the use of premium wood and materials, combined with skilled craftsmanship and attentive communication. Clients note the firm’s ability to offer design alternatives, meet deadlines, and maintain a collaborative, pleasant experience throughout the project.
